archetypes.name: dyn-discussion-contract
archetypes.rationale: Compressed prompt prose can accidentally weaken load-bearing discussion invariants.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the discussion-rounds.md compression for semantic drift. Focus on Step 1c batching and architectural-alternative permission, Step 1d sequential scope-only interrogation, and Round 2 Gate A behavior. Confirm byte-sensitive breadcrumbs, Q&A schemas, settle dispatch lines, and wrapper-only postplan routing remain intact. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
